about.text: I am Front-End web developer with 10+ years of experience. I have contributed to building high-traffic platforms, Web3 solutions, and interactive 3D projects, with both small teams and big companies, in-office and remote.
I am excited about contributing to creative passion-driven projects, I enjoy scroll-driven animation and webgl work.

Over the past years I've been moving into gameplay programming using Unreal Engine. I've collaborated on the immersive experience “Ocean Threshold” and have shipped a VR game “Gnarly Crawl” as a solo developer.
